assets.title: Outdoor Site Selection — Whole-Site Evidence Map
assets.purpose: Teach the learner to evaluate seasonal sun, drainage, slope, airflow, water access and neighboring risks together from the intended plant position.
assets.diagnosticUse: Shows why a site that looks sunny can still fail because of ponding, wind exposure, water limitations or external risk.

assets.title: Seasonal Sun & Shade Measurement
assets.purpose: Show how solar angle, day length, trees, buildings and terrain move shade across the crop position through the season.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps distinguish inadequate seasonal exposure from a one-time cloudy-day observation.

assets.title: Drainage, Ponding & Runoff Field Map
assets.purpose: Visualize water input, low spots, runoff paths, erosion, ponding duration and root-depth moisture checkpoints after real rain or irrigation.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps separate surface wetness from deeper saturation and identify repeat drainage-risk zones.

assets.title: Water Source & Delivery Capacity Test
assets.purpose: Teach timed-volume flow testing at the source and farthest delivery point, plus how runtime differs from delivered root-zone water.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps identify inadequate or uneven delivery before plants are blamed for drought-type symptoms.

assets.title: Neighbor Risk — Source, Wind & Timing Map
assets.purpose: Map pollen, spray, dust, smoke and unmanaged-vegetation sources by distance, bearing, wind overlap and susceptible timing.
assets.diagnosticUse: Prevents a nearby source from being treated as proof of causation while showing what evidence raises or lowers exposure plausibility.

assets.title: Suitable Site vs Hidden-Risk Site
assets.purpose: Compare two realistic outdoor sites that look similar at first glance but differ in late-season shade, drainage, water delivery and neighboring exposure.
assets.diagnosticUse: Trains users to look past cosmetic appearance and collect the missing measurements before choosing a site.
